tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Avahit's catalog of Amazon products by brand and category. Returns title, store domain and a link to the product page on Avahit. The current price is on Amazon: Avahit neither shows nor follows Amazon's prices.

tools.name: compare_alternatives
tools.description: Given an Avahit product id, return ranked alternatives with a match percentage explaining how close each one is (same category, price distance, product type, same store).

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Avahit's catalog of Amazon products by brand and category. Returns title, store domain and a link to the product page on Avahit. The current price is on Amazon: Avahit neither shows nor follows Amazon's prices." → after: "Search Avahit's catalog of Amazon products by brand and category. Returns title, store domain and a link to the product page on Avahit. Amazon prices are not returned: the current price is on Amazon, and Avahit keeps no Amazon price history."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
